title: Felix and the Crown
author: A. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Isandro Zhou, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
